HireQuest Reports Financial Results for Third Quarter 2026

 

GOOSE CREEK, South Carolina – November 12, 2026 – HireQuest (Nasdaq: HQI), a national franchisor of on-demand staffing and direct-hire recruiting services, today reported financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026.

 

Rick Hermanns, HireQuest’s President and Chief Executive Officer, commented, “Our third quarter results reflect continued momentum across our core commercial staffing brands, as improving demand delivered another quarter of year-over-year revenue growth. Our franchise model continues to demonstrate its resilience, allowing us to grow alongside our franchisees as they benefit from a strengthened labor market.

 

“We believe the improving demand environment we have seen throughout 2026 positions our franchisees well as we close out the year and look ahead to 2027. We have a strong balance sheet and ample liquidity, and we remain focused on disciplined capital allocation as we work to deliver consistently profitable results and enhanced value for our shareholders,” Mr. Hermanns concluded.

 

Third Quarter 2026 Review

 

Franchise royalties in the third quarter of 2026 were $8.2 million compared to $8.1 million in the prior-year period, an increase of 1.5%. Service revenue was $604,000 compared to $387,000 in the prior-year period. The third quarter of 2025 included approximately $479,000 in franchise royalties and $61,000 in MRINetwork national advertising fund fees within service revenue related to the divestiture of certain assets and liabilities associated with the permanent placement franchisee base of HQ MRI Corporation on January 1, 2026 (the "MRINetwork Assets Divestiture"). Pro forma for the MRINetwork Assets Divestiture, franchise royalties increased 7.9% in the third quarter of 2026.

 

Total revenue in the third quarter of 2026 was $8.8 million compared to $8.5 million in the prior year period, an increase of 4.0%. Pro forma for the MRINetwork Assets Divestiture, total revenue increased 11.1% in the third quarter of 2026.

 

SG&A expenses in the third quarter of 2026 were $6.1 million compared to $5.1 million in the third quarter of 2025, an increase of 20.7%. SG&A expenses in the third quarter of 2026 included $1.3 million in write down of notes receivable, primarily related to the repossession of a franchised location during the quarter. Net workers' compensation expense was approximately $434,000 in the third quarter of 2026 compared to a net workers' compensation benefit of $99,000 in the prior-year period. The third quarter of 2025 included approximately $616,000 in operating expenses related to the MRINetwork Assets Divestiture.

 

Depreciation and amortization in the third quarter of 2026 was approximately $763,000, compared to $752,000 in the third quarter of 2025.

 

Interest and other financing expense in the third quarter of 2026 was approximately $35,000 compared to $62,000 for the third quarter of 2025. Interest and other financing expense will fluctuate as the Company utilizes the line of credit for acquisitions or other short-term liquidity needs.

 

Net income in the third quarter of 2026 was $1.7 million or $0.12 per diluted share, compared to net income of $2.3 million, or $0.16 per diluted share, in the third quarter of 2025. The decrease in net income for the quarter was primarily attributable to the approximately $1.3 million in write down of notes receivable, primarily related to the repossession of a franchised location and higher net workers’ compensation expense.

 

Adjusted net income for the third quarter of 2026 was $3.0 million, or $0.22 per diluted share compared to adjusted net income of $3.3 million, or $0.23 per diluted share, in the third quarter of 2025.

 

Adjusted EBITDA for the third quarter of 2026 was $4.5 million, consistent with adjusted EBITDA in the third quarter of 2025.

 

System-wide sales for the third quarter of 2026 were $131.2 million compared to $133.6 million for the third quarter of 2025. The decrease was primarily driven by $15.8 million in system-wide sales related to the MRINetwork Assets Divestiture, partially offset by a $7.5 million increase in system-wide sales of HireQuest Direct and a $6.6 million increase in system-wide sales of Snelling. Pro forma for the MRINetwork Assets Divestiture, system-wide sales increased 11.4% in the third quarter of 2026.

 

Year-To-Date 2026 Review

 

Franchise royalties for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 were $21.8 million compared to $22.3 million for the same period in 2025, a decrease of 1.9%. Service revenue was $1.6 million compared to $1.3 million in the prior-year period. The nine months ended September 30, 2025 included approximately $1.6 million in franchise royalties and $205,000 in service revenue related to the MRINetwork Assets Divestiture. Pro forma for the MRINetwork Assets Divestiture, franchise royalties increased 5.7% for the period.

 

Total revenue was $23.4 million compared to $23.5 million in the same year-ago period, a decrease of 0.5%. The nine months ended September 30, 2025 included approximately $1.8 million of total revenue related to the MRINetwork Assets Divestiture. Pro forma for the MRINetwork Assets Divestiture, total revenue increased 7.8% for the period.

 

SG&A expenses in the first nine months of 2026 were $14.4 million compared to $16.2 million for the same period of 2025, a decrease of 11.1%. Workers' compensation expense was approximately $513,000 for the first nine months ended September 30, 2026 compared to approximately $56,000 in the prior-year period. The nine months ended September 30, 2025 included approximately $1.9 million in operating expenses related to the MRINetwork Assets Divestiture, $1.1 million in acquisition related charges, and $350,000 in write down of notes receivable expense. The nine months ended September 30, 2026 included a non-cash loss of approximately $1.5 million in write down of notes receivable expense, primarily related to the repossession of a franchised location in the third quarter of 2026.

 

Depreciation and amortization in the first nine months of 2026 was approximately $2.3 million, up slightly compared with $2.2 million in the first nine months of 2025.

 

Interest and other financing expense for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 was approximately $72,000 compared to $277,000 in the prior year period. Interest and other financing expense will fluctuate as the Company utilizes the line of credit for acquisitions or other short-term liquidity needs.

 

Net income in the 2026 year-to-date period was $5.9 million or $0.43 per diluted share, compared to net income of $4.7 million, or $0.34 per diluted share, in the same year-ago period.

 

Adjusted net income for the nine-month period was $8.1 million, or $0.59 per diluted share compared to adjusted net income of $7.2 million, or $0.52 per diluted share, in the first nine months of 2025.

 

Adjusted EBITDA for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 was $11.8 million compared to $10.6 million in the same prior-year period.

 

System-wide sales for the first nine months of 2026 were $351.6 million compared to $377.9 million in the same period of 2025. The decrease was primarily driven by the loss of $49.4 million in system-wide sales as a result of the MRINetwork Assets Divestiture. Pro forma for the MRINetwork Assets Divestiture, system-wide sales increased 7.1% for the period.

 

Balance Sheet and Capital Structure

 

Cash was $1.1 million as of September 30, 2026, compared to $3.9 million as of December 31, 2025. Total assets were $95.7 million as of September 30, 2026, compared to $88.2 million as of December 31, 2025. Total liabilities were $25.7 million as of September 30, 2026, compared to $19.9 million as of December 31, 2025.

 

Working capital as of September 30, 2026, was $38.0 million compared to $33.0 million as of December 31, 2025.

 

As of September 30, 2026, assuming continued covenant compliance, availability under the line of credit was approximately $40.5 million based on eligible collateral, less letter of credit reserves, bank product reserves, and current advances.

 

During the third quarter of 2026, the Company paid a quarterly cash dividend of $0.06 per share of common stock, declared on September 1, 2026. The Company intends to pay a $0.06 cash dividend on a quarterly basis, but the declaration of any dividend and the exact amount each quarter will be based on its business results and financial position and is subject to board of directors’ discretion.

About HireQuest

HireQuest is a franchisor of staffing solutions with a footprint across the U.S. and international markets. Through its primary divisions - HireQuest Direct, HireQuest Health, Snelling, TradeCorp and DriverQuest - the company delivers temporary, direct-hire, and contract workforce solutions across a wide range of industries, including construction, light industrial, healthcare, finance, manufacturing, hospitality, logistics and more. From on-demand staffing to direct hire recruiting, HireQuest’s divisions work together to provide workforce solutions that help businesses grow and create meaningful opportunities for the communities we serve. For more information, visit www.hirequest.com

Non-U.S. GAAP Financial Measures

 

This document contains supplemental financial information determined by methods other than in accordance with accounting principles generally accepted in the United States of America (“U.S. GAAP”). Management uses these non-U.S. GAAP measures in its analysis of the Company’s performance. These measures should not be considered a substitute for U.S. GAAP basis measures nor should they be viewed as a substitute for operating results determined in accordance with U.S. GAAP. Management believes the presentation of non-U.S. GAAP financial measures that exclude the impact of specified items provide useful supplemental information that is essential to a proper understanding of the Company’s financial condition and results. Non-U.S. GAAP measures are not formally defined under U.S. GAAP, and other entities may use calculation methods that differ from those used by us. As a complement to U.S. GAAP financial measures, our management believes these non-U.S. GAAP financial measures assist investors in comparing the financial condition and results of operations of financial institutions due to the industry prevalence of such non-U.S. GAAP measures.
